basics.name: Dmitry Leiko
basics.headline: Senior Backend Engineer · PHP / Python · Zend Certified Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer, 10+ years: PHP/Symfony and Python/Django. Since 2023 — microservices for one of the largest online retailers in Belarus: I design around DDD and own a service from its domain model to production on Kubernetes.
basics.location: Minsk, Belarus · Open to remote or relocation

experience.context: One of the largest online retailers in Belarus — electronics, appliances and a retail marketplace.
bullets: Build and maintain microservices end to end — domain model, service boundaries, code review, production support — each modelled around its business domain so it stays changeable as catalogue and order rules evolve.
Work mostly in the cart and delivery domain: how a cart is assembled and priced down to promo-code discounts, and which delivery methods and time slots a customer is offered at checkout.

Built 21vek Post, a new parcel-shipping service, with the team: parcel creation, shipping-cost calculation for add-on services, and a two-way exchange with 1C through a transactional outbox and message brokers.
Moved the site from the CakePHP monolith to Next.js page by page — home, listings, product card, pickup, order history — with HAProxy routing between old and new code.

Built the auto-parts finder backend: search by VIN or car model, a catalogue of assemblies with parts diagrams, originals and analogues from TradeSoft; part cards are assembled from events across seven topics.
Use Claude Code day to day for code generation, review and getting into unfamiliar code, extended with my own skills and plugins and with tools wired in over MCP.
Write analytics and data-processing tooling: reporting pipelines and ad-hoc analysis, run on a schedule.

experience.context: Belarusian hosting, domain and cloud-services provider.
bullets: Extended the customer account area and the internal CRM: management of services, hosting and domains, plus website monitoring.
Integrated third-party APIs with internal services, keeping provider changes isolated from the products that depended on them.
Set up, tuned and integrated Sphinx full-text search into the services.
Estimated incoming work, built and evolved client projects, and planned tasks for junior engineers.
Rebuilt the cart of a US phone-number purchasing service from scratch: multiple numbers per order, a cart countdown timer and caching.
Introduced Docker and CI/CD, replacing manual builds and deployments.

experience.context: International software engineering and IT-consulting firm.
bullets: Built projects from scratch and extended existing ones for enterprise clients, with builds and deployments running through Jenkins.
Also maintained WordPress/WooCommerce online stores.
Supported the company's products and resolved production failures promptly.
Connected external services over APIs.

experience.context: Independent contracting for web studios and direct clients.
bullets: Turned PSD designs of varying complexity into page templates, from landing pages to multi-page company sites.

projects.name: find-apartment
projects.blurb: Rental-listing scanner for Kufar and Realt.by that de-duplicates against SQLite and pushes only unseen listings to Telegram with photos and coordinates; price and room filters are changed live by chat command.
bullets: Runs every 10 minutes; a single-poller guard turns Telegram 409 conflicts into a clear startup refusal instead of silent message loss.
Typed and linted end to end, with tests and image publishing in CI on every push.
